Tell them their mother has come back.","sfx_cue":"police station gate clangs, crowd murmuring"},{"speaker":"kavita","text":"Stop there. Do not cross the desk until I ask you.","sfx_cue":"wooden desk struck once"},{"speaker":"meera","text":"Then ask quickly. I have waited... I have waited long enough.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"kavita","text":"Your name.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"Meera. Devraj's daughter. Tara and Mohan's mother.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"VOICE IN CROWD","text":"She says she is the dead woman.","sfx_cue":"crowd presses closer"},{"speaker":"SECOND VOICE IN CROWD","text":"Call her father. Let him see her face.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"He will know me. Bring him here. Please.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"kavita","text":"Constable, shut the gate. Nobody leaves, and nobody touches her.","sfx_cue":"metal gate slams"},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"Move aside. I will settle this.","sfx_cue":"walking stick taps across concrete"},{"speaker":"meera","text":"Baba...","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"Do not call me that.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"Look at me. Properly. The cut above my eyebrow, I got it on your grain scale. You carried me home.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"Many people have scars.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"Your left knee hurts before you sit. You hide money inside the red account book. Baba, please... just hold my hand.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"Do not touch me.","sfx_cue":"crowd falls quiet"},{"speaker":"meera","text":"One touch. You will know.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"I buried my daughter. I placed wood on her pyre with these hands. You are an impostor.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"VOICE IN CROWD","text":"Her own father will not touch her.","sfx_cue":"uneasy whispering"},{"speaker":"SECOND VOICE IN CROWD","text":"Someone trained her. Why else would she come here?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"I came for my children. Where are Tara and Mohan?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"My grandchildren have already suffered. They will not be displayed before a stranger.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"They are not your shield. Bring them.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"Sub-inspector, remove this woman before Tara hears this filth in the market.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"kavita","text":"No. She entered a police station and made an identity claim. We record it before anyone removes anyone.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"The police recorded her death. Is your own record now a rumour?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"kavita","text":"One fact at a time. Meera, when did you last see your children?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"The morning I disappeared. Tara would not drink her milk. Mohan had fever... no, the fever began the night before.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"All of that was discussed after the funeral. Anyone in Dharmapur could repeat it.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"Not this. Mohan called fever medicine bitter rain. Tara drew a moustache on the bottle so he would laugh.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"Enough.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"You know that happened.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"I know grief makes foolish people generous with information.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"kavita","text":"Babulal, bring the death entry and the original identification file.","sfx_cue":"keys rattle at record-room door"},{"speaker":"babulal","text":"Madam, that file is sealed with the murder case.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"kavita","text":"Then open the cupboard, not the seal.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"babulal","text":"If the woman is genuine, every connected page will have to be reviewed.","sfx_cue":"steel cupboard creaks open"},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"If. Please remember that word.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"Show me what you wrote about me.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"babulal","text":"There is a death certificate, cremation acknowledgement, family identification and a station register entry.","sfx_cue":"thick register lands on desk"},{"speaker":"meera","text":"And my children were made to live under those pages.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"kavita","text":"Give me the date and status.","sfx_cue":"register pages turning"},{"speaker":"babulal","text":"Fourteenth November, two thousand twenty-two. Meera, daughter of Devraj, recorded deceased.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"I am standing in front of you.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"babulal","text":"The station register still lists Meera as dead.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"kavita","text":"And four men are in jail for murdering her.","sfx_cue":""}]},{"ep":2,"title":"The Wrong Hand","lines":[{"speaker":"devraj","text":"If that woman goes near Tara or Mohan, I will hold this station responsible for what it does to them.","sfx_cue":"crowd pounds on interview-room door"},{"speaker":"kavita","text":"Your concern is noted. Now step away from the door.","sfx_cue":"door bolt slides shut"},{"speaker":"meera","text":"Do not send him away. Let him hear every answer.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"kavita","text":"No. Private details are useful only when the crowd cannot feed them to you.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"She already knows enough to perform.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"kavita","text":"You will wait outside until I call you.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"This is my daughter's case.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"kavita","text":"That is precisely why you do not conduct the test.","sfx_cue":"door opens, crowd swells"},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"Very well. Test her. But do not mistake confidence for truth.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"kavita","text":"Close it.","sfx_cue":"door shuts, crowd muffled"},{"speaker":"meera","text":"How long before I see my children?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"kavita","text":"When I can put you near them without turning two children into evidence.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"They are already evidence. Everyone outside is saying their mother's name.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"kavita","text":"Sit. One fact at a time.","sfx_cue":"metal chair scrapes"},{"speaker":"meera","text":"I cannot sit quietly while Baba calls me an impostor.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"kavita","text":"Then sit angrily.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"You think I am lying.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"kavita","text":"I think the register says you are dead, you say you are alive, and four prisoners cannot both have murdered you and not murdered you.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"Ask me something.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"kavita","text":"What did Devraj break on the day Tara was born?","sfx_cue":"notebook opens"},{"speaker":"meera","text":"Nothing. He claimed the tea glass broke by itself. Actually, he squeezed it when the nurse said the baby was a girl.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"kavita","text":"Where did the glass cut him?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"Between his thumb and first finger. He hid the bandage before entering my room.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"kavita","text":"What did he bring you?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"Two oranges and the wrong slippers. Both were for the right foot.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"kavita","text":"What colour?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"Green, with silver flowers. I wore them anyway because he looked so ashamed.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"kavita","text":"Mohan's first word.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"Not Ma. Everyone says Ma. It was wheel. He pointed at Baba's bicycle and said it until he slept.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"kavita","text":"What frightens Tara?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"People knowing she is frightened. She will stand near any snake if someone is watching. Alone, she cannot even touch a shed snakeskin.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"kavita","text":"That answer may matter later.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"It matters now. Bring her.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"kavita","text":"Not yet.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"You keep saying not yet. I heard that for months. Food, not yet. Outside, not yet. Home... not yet.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"kavita","text":"Who said that to you?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"I will give a full statement. First let my children see my face.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"kavita","text":"Your conditions do not control this inquiry.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"And my father's fear should not control it either.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"kavita","text":"Correct.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"Then why is he still the one deciding who I am?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"kavita","text":"He is not.","sfx_cue":"door bolt snaps back"},{"speaker":"kavita","text":"Devraj. Come in alone.","sfx_cue":"door opens, crowd murmuring"},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"Has she failed?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"kavita","text":"She answered six questions. Four match your earlier family statement exactly. Two were never in the file.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"Then someone in the family spoke carelessly.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"Say my name once while looking at me.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"I will not reward manipulation.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"kavita","text":"Did you break a tea glass when Tara was born?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"I may have. That was many years ago.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"kavita","text":"Did you bring two right-foot slippers?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"Small family stories travel. Evidence does not.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"kavita","text":"You said you brought evidence.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"I did.","sfx_cue":"paper envelope placed on desk"},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"The hospital photographed the burned body before identification. I identified the tattoo and the black thread tied at the wrist.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"My mother tied that thread after Mohan's fever. I never removed it.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"The body had the same thread. The same tattoo. That is why I signed.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"kavita","text":"Describe your tattoo without looking at the photograph.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"Three dots above a small crooked leaf. The woman made the last line too deep. It is here, on my left hand.","sfx_cue":"cloth sleeve pulled back"},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"A tattoo can be copied after the case becomes public.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"After? Look closely. The leaf has stretched with my skin. This is not new.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"kavita","text":"Babulal, bring the identification record.","sfx_cue":"door opens"},{"speaker":"babulal","text":"Madam, the hospital note says black thread at wrist and tattoo visible beside it.","sfx_cue":"file pages rustle"},{"speaker":"kavita","text":"Does it specify left or right?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"babulal","text":"No. Only the photograph shows the side.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"I saw the mark. I had just lost my daughter. Do not examine my grief as though it were a crime.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"kavita","text":"I am examining the identification.","sfx_cue":"magnifying glass taps photograph"},{"speaker":"meera","text":"Which hand?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"The image may have been reversed during printing.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"babulal","text":"The hospital number is readable, not reversed.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"Which hand, madam? Please... say it.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"kavita","text":"The photograph shows the tattoo on the body is on the opposite hand from Meera's tattoo.","sfx_cue":""}]},{"ep":3,"title":"Behind the Locked Door","lines":[{"speaker":"meera","text":"Open the gate. My children are inside that house.","sfx_cue":"police jeep brakes, iron house gate rattles"},{"speaker":"kavita","text":"You enter under police guard, and you do not force either child to approach you.","sfx_cue":"jeep engine cuts out"},{"speaker":"meera","text":"I am not forcing them. I am coming home.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"This has not been her home since the cremation.","sfx_cue":"walking stick strikes stone"},{"speaker":"meera","text":"You burned another woman's body and gave away my room. Neither act changes whose house this is.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"kavita","text":"The body identification is under review. Do not state conclusions before the evidence does.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"Then let the evidence open the gate.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"tara","text":"I will open it.","sfx_cue":"gate latch lifts from inside"},{"speaker":"meera","text":"Tara.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"tara","text":"Do not call me like that.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"Like what?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"tara","text":"Like you have been searching every room and finally found me.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"That is exactly how I am calling you.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"tara","text":"Sub-inspector, you said she was only coming to look at the house.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"kavita","text":"She is here to identify private details. You may stay, or you may leave the room.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"tara","text":"I am staying.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"Where is Mohan?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"tara","text":"He does not want to see you.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"mohan","text":"That is not what I said!","sfx_cue":"boy shouts behind wooden door"},{"speaker":"meera","text":"Mohan? Open the door, little wheel.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"mohan","text":"No!","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"tara","text":"He locked himself in the storeroom when the jeep came.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"He is frightened.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"tara","text":"He is confused. There is a difference.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"This is why I refused. The boy has already mourned once.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"Because you told him I was ashes.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"Because I identified his mother's body.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"kavita","text":"Enough. Tara, show us the rooms without giving her clues.","sfx_cue":"courtyard footsteps begin"},{"speaker":"tara","text":"Fine. If she is my mother, she should not need clues.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"I do not.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"tara","text":"Then start here. What was kept in that wall niche?","sfx_cue":"pigeons flutter under roof tiles"},{"speaker":"meera","text":"The brass lamp. Except during exams, when you hid your school timetable behind it.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"tara","text":"Anybody could have seen the lamp.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"Nobody saw the sums you wrote on the wall behind the timetable. Seven times eight was fifty-four until I made you correct it.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"tara","text":"I was small.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"You cried because the wrong answer looked neater.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"Tara, you do not have to listen.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"tara","text":"I said I am staying.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"kavita","text":"Next room.","sfx_cue":"wooden threshold creaks"},{"speaker":"tara","text":"What was under the bed?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"A steel trunk, one broken sandal and Mohan whenever he stole jaggery.","sfx_cue":"small movement behind locked door"},{"speaker":"mohan","text":"I did not steal it.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"No. The jaggery climbed into your pocket by itself.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"mohan","text":"Maybe.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"Open the door. I will not come close. I only want to see how tall you are.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"mohan","text":"If I open it, will the police take you away?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"I don't... I cannot promise what the police will do. But I will not leave without telling you.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"kavita","text":"No one is taking her away today unless evidence requires it.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"mohan","text":"That is not a promise.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"kavita","text":"No. It is the truth.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"Mohan, remember the tune I used when your chest hurt?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"tara","text":"Do not sing it.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"Why?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"tara","text":"Because he wants you to be her. He will believe anything if you use her voice.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"My voice did not die because you were told I did.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"tara","text":"You know stories. You know rooms. You even look like the photographs. But I will not call you mother.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"Not today?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"tara","text":"Not until I decide.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"You have heard her. This visit should end.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"No. My room is left.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"That room is used for storage now.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"Then your storage is sleeping in my room.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"kavita","text":"Open it.","sfx_cue":"key enters old lock"},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"There is nothing relevant inside.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"kavita","text":"You do not decide relevance.","sfx_cue":"lock turns, door groans open"},{"speaker":"meera","text":"The blue wall is gone.","sfx_cue":"footsteps enter dusty room"},{"speaker":"tara","text":"It was painted after the funeral.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"My mirror was on that nail. The cot faced east. I kept Tara's first school ribbon inside the mirror frame.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"tara","text":"The mirror broke years ago.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"Then the ribbon may still be behind the loose brick below the nail.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"kavita","text":"Tara, were you aware of that hiding place?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"tara","text":"No.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"There are dozens of loose bricks in an old house.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"Third brick from the corner. It has a white scratch shaped like a hook.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"kavita","text":"Do not help her. I will check.","sfx_cue":"brick scrapes against plaster"},{"speaker":"tara","text":"There is something inside.","sfx_cue":"small tin box opens"},{"speaker":"kavita","text":"A faded school ribbon, blue and white.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"You cried on your first morning, Tara. So I cut my own blue scarf and tied a matching ribbon around my wrist.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"tara","text":"A hidden object proves you knew this house. It does not prove why you left it.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"I did not leave you willingly.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"There. Now comes the accusation that protects her from every question.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"kavita","text":"She has not given the allegation yet.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"I will. But not while he turns every word into shame.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"tara","text":"Then answer me without him. Why did you not come back?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"Because I could not. Because every time I thought I had a road home, someone closed it. I tried to remember your faces exactly, but Mohan kept growing in my head and you... you stayed thirteen.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"tara","text":"I was fourteen when you disappeared.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"No. Your birthday was eleven days later. I had hidden your present in the grain drum.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"tara","text":"What present?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"Red glass bangles. You said you were too old for dolls and too young for gold. I never got to give them to you.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"Tara, enough. Pain is not proof.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"tara","text":"I know.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"mohan","text":"Is she crying?","sfx_cue":"fingers touch door from inside"},{"speaker":"tara","text":"Stay inside, Mohan.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"mohan","text":"I want to see her.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"tara","text":"Then why did you lock the door?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"mohan","text":"Because if she is not Ma, I will lose her again.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"You do not have to open it today. I will sit outside.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"You will not occupy this courtyard until the village accepts you.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"kavita","text":"The village does not issue identity certificates.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"The village will still remember who brought scandal to its doors.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"kavita","text":"And it will remember who refused evidence when it was placed in his hand.","sfx_cue":"rapid knocking at outer gate"},{"speaker":"VOICE AT GATE","text":"Police!
